title: Layout Master — GIS Urban Planning & Auction Platform
description: Enterprise GIS land layout and civic site management system enabling urban planning authorities to map geographic parcels, manage site master data, govern auction eligibility, and configure role-based civic workflows.
bullets: Database & Master Entities: Designed 5 core master tables in MySQL using TypeORM (Person, Post, Role, Permission, Menu) with unique constraints and soft-delete audit fields.
Relational Mappings Architecture: Architected 4 relational mapping tables (Post-to-Person with tenure dates, Role-to-Post, Menu-to-Role, Permission-to-Role) governing structural access.
Multi-Layered NestJS Backend: Built modular RESTful APIs utilizing Controllers, DTOs with class-validator, Services for business logic, and TypeORM Custom Repositories protected by JWT guards.
Dynamic Authorization & RBAC: Implemented a runtime RBAC engine evaluating user Post and Role to dynamically resolve allowed navigation menus and granular CRUD permissions.
Reactive Frontend & State Sync: Developed high-density data grid interfaces using React 19, TypeScript, TanStack Table v8, and TanStack Query v5 with automated cache invalidation.

title: KEONICS — Karnataka State Electronics Development Corporation ERP
description: State government enterprise ERP engineered for KEONICS (Karnataka State Electronics Development Corporation) governing IT park facilities, tenant space allotments, role-based approval workflows, and expenditure audits.
bullets: Workflow JSON Schema & Process Graph: Designed structured JSON process graphs (processmaster.json) capturing taskId, process_id, task_type (STARTTASK, NORMAL, DECISION, ENDTASK), and branching decision_flows (Approve, Clarification, Reject) to govern application lifecycles.

Database Schema & Instance Tracking: Architected TypeORM entities and custom repositories (process_instance, task_instance, task_history) in MySQL to track active workflow pointers, task assignments, and lifecycle states.

Role-Based State Machine & Task Mapping: Implemented a backend state transition engine using a TaskToRole lookup dictionary to dynamically map each workflow task to authorized roles (Estate Officer, Zone Commissioner, Commissioner).

Validation & Action Payloads: Engineered RESTful action endpoints (POST /send-for-approval, PUT /close-task/:id) using NestJS DTOs and class-validator, where officers submit decisions, mandatory audit comments, and verification data.
Traceable Audit History: Logged every transition into a history table containing previous state, new state, acting actor ID (Actor A or Actor B), remarks, and timestamps for compliance auditing.

title: IEBA — Bits of Time (Workforce & Time Study Platform)
description: Enterprise multi-tenant workforce analytics and time-study platform built for Bits of Time, governing industrial engineering workflows, personal & scheduled time studies, FTE allocation, activity-based cost pools, and payroll.
bullets: Assigned Program & Activity Resolution Engine: Developed backend APIs to dynamically fetch and filter only the assigned programs and active industrial activities mapped to an employee's department role, ensuring accurate logging.

Personal Time Study (PTS) Logging & Validation: Engineered the core time-entry APIs (/user/timeentry/record, /submit) with strict DTO validation that records activity start/end times and total minutes while preventing overlapping time intervals.

Supervisor Review & Approval Pipeline: Built the supervisor review workflow (/timestudyrecord/:id/review) enabling managers to fetch their reportees' submitted weekly time studies, inspect activity breakdowns, and approve or reject them with feedback.

Scheduled Time Study (STS) Configuration: Architected the scheduled time study module allowing administrators to create time study schedules, assign specific eligible users, and restrict logging strictly within the scheduled time windows.

Backend Services & Frontend API Integration: Implemented modular NestJS controllers, TypeORM services, and relational MySQL schemas, seamlessly integrating with the React frontend to synchronize employee time logs and supervisor approval queues.

title: CAS — Civic Amenity Site Allotment & Registration Portal
description: Government allotment portal for Civic Amenity (CA) sites and institutional registrations, featuring multilingual localization (English & Kannada), SMS OTP authentication, digital certificate issuance, and S3-backed document verification.
bullets: Developed end-to-end civic applicant and CA-site allotment modules with multi-step registration, form validation (Zod + React Hook Form), and refund processing.
Integrated multilingual support using react-i18next alongside secure SMS-based OTP authentication for civic citizens and administrative staff.
Built automated digital certificate generation, S3 document pipelines, and high-concurrency NestJS APIs backed by MySQL and Redis caching.

title: Timesheet — Enterprise Workforce & Attendance Management
description: Multi-role enterprise timesheet and attendance platform featuring role-based dashboards (Admin, Manager, Employee), automated submission locking, hierarchy mapping, leave management, and PDF report generation.
bullets: Architected 3 distinct role dashboards (Admin, Manager, Employee) with timesheet logging, leave request approvals, and dynamic manager-employee hierarchy mapping.
Engineered automated timesheet locking, Bull queue background jobs for deadline reminders, and mail alert pipelines.
Implemented interactive analytics dashboards using ApexCharts & Recharts, along with automated client-side PDF timesheet export via jsPDF.

title: CDRMS — Correct Dimension Report Management System
description: Government land survey and field inspection mobile & cloud platform for Public Works Department engineers, handling on-site dimension audits, geotagged evidence, and multi-tier CAO approvals.
bullets: Engineered cross-platform mobile app with GPS geotagging, on-site photo/video evidence capture, and offline draft states.
Built field survey modules for Khatedar verification, parcel dimension calculations, and road classification reports.
Integrated multi-tier approval pipelines (Field Officer, Assistant Engineer, CAO) backed by NestJS transactions & MySQL.

title: Voice Excel Assistant — Next.js 15 Web App
description: Interactive voice-driven spreadsheet web application powered by Next.js 15 App Router and OpenAI Whisper, providing hands-free cell data entry with column-aware smart formatting and auto-saving.
bullets: Engineered hands-free voice transcription with OpenAI Whisper API & Web Speech API with smart column formatting for dates and names.
Implemented auto-saving grid engine with 500ms debounce sync to backend, row-level locking, and search filters.
Built responsive desktop and mobile spreadsheet interfaces with Framer Motion transitions.

title: Voice Excel Assistant — NestJS Backend API
description: High-performance NestJS 10 REST API powering the Voice Excel spreadsheet engine, featuring JWT authentication, automated MySQL persistence, ExcelJS file streaming, and auto-seeding.
bullets: Built modular REST API with versioned endpoints (/api/v1) for workbook CRUD, cell grid snapshots, and session management.
Integrated TypeORM with MySQL for automated schema synchronization and row-level data consistency.
Engineered ExcelJS streaming pipelines for real-time .xlsx workbook generation and secure file downloads.

title: Smart Healthcare System — AI Symptom Analysis & Scheduling
description: Comprehensive MERN-stack telemedicine platform designed for intelligent symptom analysis, specialist doctor appointment scheduling, and role-based clinic administration.
bullets: Developed an AI-guided symptom checker offering preliminary medical insights and intelligent specialist doctor recommendations.
Engineered doctor appointment booking with time-slot management, booking confirmations, and patient medical record history.
Implemented secure multi-role portal (Admin, Doctor, Patient) with JWT authentication and responsive clinic dashboard.

title: Modern Developer Portfolio — Personal Showcase
description: High-performance developer portfolio built with Vite, React 19, Tailwind CSS, and custom design tokens, featuring interactive offer letter document modal, contact system, and responsive animations.
bullets: Engineered custom dual-section project showcase distinguishing real-world enterprise platforms from self-built applications.
Built accessible document modal viewer with backdrop blur, scroll locking, and ESC key handling.
Crafted responsive editorial UI with dark-navy surfaces, gold accents, and fluid typography.

title: Interactive School & Academy Dashboard
description: Modern educational administrative dashboard developed during initial intern training at Inventech, featuring student enrollment management, class scheduling, and academic performance tracking.
bullets: Designed responsive academic calendar and timetable scheduling interface using React Big Calendar and Lucide icons.
Built dynamic analytics dashboards with Recharts displaying attendance rates, subject distributions, and exam statistics.
Integrated robust client-side form validation with React Hook Form, Zod schemas, and custom modal dialogs.

title: Online Multi-Vehicle Rental System
description: End-to-end vehicle rental booking portal supporting cars, bikes, and commercial trucks with real-time fleet availability, rental calculator, and admin verification.
bullets: Built vehicle catalog filtering by vehicle class, brand, body type, and daily rental rate.
Developed complete booking reservation workflow with rental duration calculator and automated PDF voucher generation.
Implemented administrative dashboard for fleet inventory management, reservation approvals, and customer feedback moderation.

title: Realtime Chat & Messaging Platform
description: Real-time communication and bot platform built with Node.js, Express, and Socket.IO featuring live typing indicators, active participant rosters, and instant room message delivery.
bullets: Engineered bidirectional WebSocket event architecture using Socket.IO for low-latency live messaging.
Built active participant rosters, typing indicator triggers, and room broadcasting event pipelines.
Designed lightweight, responsive web chat client running seamlessly across desktop and mobile browsers.

title: Pharmacy Management System — ERP & Inventory
description: Desktop inventory, prescription, and billing software engineered for pharmacies to manage drug stock levels, automated invoice printing, and supplier transaction histories.
bullets: Engineered drug inventory tracking with low-stock alerts, expiry date monitoring, and batch number auditing.
Built point-of-sale billing module with automated tax calculation, invoice printing, and customer ledger management.
Designed normalized relational MySQL database with JDBC transaction safety for robust operational records.
